SRC-305:R001.text: SAIPEN admission enforcement: a development Write/Edit or consequential Bash for SAIPEN-managed work must require an authoritative start/claim receipt and an active STATE-bound DOING owned by the actor BEFORE the first mutation. Retrospective phase replay is explicitly insufficient. Test a new request against phase:DONE task:none: tools refuse before claim, succeed after claim, and preserve non-mutating reads.

SRC-305:R002.text: SAIPEN SHIP/closure must not let a ticket-scoped operator no-publication decision silently govern a different later ticket. Publication policy must be represented as structured scoped authority {scope, source_receipt, tickets, effective_until, owner}; an uncovered ticket records SHIP_PUBLICATION_PENDING and needs an operator decision instead of auto-commit/push.

SRC-305:R003.text: SAIPEN invocation must record and expose concrete runtime provenance: project_root, resolved saipen_home, actual executable path, version/hash, and refuse consequential work on an unresolved install mismatch (INSTALL_IDENTITY_MISMATCH / RUNTIME_DRIFT already exist as registered codes); snapshot, live-runtime and UI-projection counters must stay distinguishable.
